name: Giving Testimony
overview: Scripture emphasizes giving testimony as a vital response to God's enduring mercy and grace, encouraging believers to proclaim the great things the Lord has done for them, as Jesus instructed the healed man to share his experience with others. The Spirit of truth testifies of Christ, and believers are called to bear witness because of their close relationship with Him. Our conduct and conversation should reflect the gospel, standing united in faith as a living testimony to the transformative power of Christ.
